articles.summary: L3Harris Technologies and Osrodek Badawczo – Rozwojowy Centrum Techniki Morskiej S.A. (CTM), a member of Polska Grupa Zbrojeniowa S.A. (PGZ), have signed a Memorandum of Understanding for the potential in-country production of a Polish WIDMO Combat Team Radio.
articles.title: L3Harris Signs Agreement with CTM for Tactical Communications Production in Poland

articles.title: If the Best AI Wins, America Must Build It

articles.summary: L3Harris Technologies has completed production of the first 35 Viper Shield electronic warfare and countermeasure systems for the global F-16 fleet.
articles.title: L3Harris Completes Production of First F-16 Viper Shield Electronic Warfare Systems

articles.summary: L3Harris has spent more than two decades building, operating and continuously modernizing the world's largest air traffic surveillance system – tracking and managing commercial air traffic across the entire U.S. National Airspace System precision and reliability.
articles.title: Protecting the Homeland: A Proven Nationwide Network and Its Potential to Defend America

articles.summary: L3Harris Technologies has received an undefinitized contract award from Lockheed Martin, valued at $4.7 billion over seven years, to produce propulsion systems for the PAC-3® Missile Segment Enhancement (MSE) interceptor.
articles.title: L3Harris Receives Landmark PAC‑3 MSE Propulsion Contract to Power America’s Arsenal of Freedom

articles.summary: L3Harris Technologies has been selected by the U.S. Navy to deliver VAMPIRE counter-unmanned systems (C-UxS) in support of the U.S.’ growing integrated C-UxS defense architecture.
articles.title: L3Harris Delivering Counter-Drone Systems to US Navy
